about: Your repeated design tasks, the steps each takes by hand, and who does each step now: auto = the loop does it · removed = no longer human work · human = a person still does it · na = doesn't apply. tools/coverage/coverage.js matches USELOG runs to tasks (first `match` regex on the heading wins; put the catch-all last) and reports the automated share. Edit the tasks, the steps and the `manual` list to fit your job.

steps.S1: Read the request, write the brief — ask once if ambiguous
steps.S2: Find tokens, components, project rules, taste
steps.S4: Measure: overflow, clipping, contrast, tap targets, wrapping, font coverage
steps.S5: Capture every width and theme, or every frame
steps.S6: Review against taste (hierarchy, alignment, accent dose, consistency…)
steps.S8: Final approval, pick a direction, decide
steps.S9: Hand off: screenshots, what changed, what is still uncertain
steps.S10: Turn lessons into rules for next time
steps.S12: Check on a real device after deploy

tasks.name: Review a flow, check against a spec

manual.name: Example: hand assets to developers outside code
